how_to_apply: Visit the official RIMS website at rimsranchi.ac.in.
Open the Recruitment section and locate the advertisement for Operational Manager–Health Insurance, Floor Co-ordinator and Ayushman Mitra.
Read the educational qualifications, experience requirements, age limits and interview instructions.
Download or print the prescribed application form included in the recruitment advertisement.
Enter the post name, personal information, address, category and educational qualification details.
Attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, marksheets, experience certificates and other applicable documents.
Sign the completed application form and declaration.
Prepare a separate application form if applying for more than one post.
Confirm the interview date through the official RIMS recruitment website.
Report to the Office of the Director, RIMS, Ranchi, between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM on the confirmed interview date.
Submit the application and produce the original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: RIMS Ranchi has advertised 113 vacancies across three posts . Ayushman Mitra accounts for 100 vacancies, followed by Floor Co-ordinator with 12 posts and Operational Manager–Health Insurance with one post.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Official Recruitment Notices: View RIMS Ranchi Recruitment Notices Candidates should obtain the final authenticated notice, including the confirmed interview date, from the official recruitment website before attending.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications and experience requirements vary by post. Candidates applying for Operational Manager and Floor Co-ordinator must meet the respective experience requirements, while Ayushman Mitra applicants must satisfy the prescribed education and computer qualification conditions. MBA in Healthcare or Master's degree in Health from a regular university. Minimum five years of experience implementing a Government Health Insurance Programme. Fluent communication skills in English and Hindi. Functional computer literacy, including MS Office and internet portals. Graduation in any discipline. Minimum two years of experience implementing a Government Health Programme or Health Insurance programme in a managerial capacity. Minimum one-year certificate course in Computer Operation. Fluent communication skills in English and Hindi. Computer proficiency, including MS Office and internet portals. Completed Class 12 from a recognized Board of Education. Six-month Diploma in Computer Application (DCA) certificate. Experience certificate as Arogya Mitra will be given preference. Fluent communication skills in English, Hindi and the local language. Computer literacy, including MS Office and internet portals. Important: Candidates applying for Ayushman Mitra must possess both the required 12th Pass qualification and six-month DCA certificate. The notification lists prior Arogya Mitra experience as a preference rather than a compulsory eligibility requirement.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years for General candidates , with relaxation for eligible reserved categories. Age is calculated as on the walk-in interview date. Female candidates will receive an additional three years of age relaxation according to the applicable Government of Jharkhand rules, over and above their respective category limits.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The remuneration differs by post. Operational Manager and Floor Co-ordinator carry consolidated monthly payments, while Ayushman Mitra receives payment on a successful-case basis.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through a walk-in interview and verification of eligibility documents . Candidates must appear with the completed prescribed application form, self-attested document copies and original certificates. Submission of the completed application form at the interview venue. Verification of educational qualifications, experience and supporting certificates. Walk-in interview of eligible candidates. Selection under the institutional recruitment conditions. The notification does not specify a separate written examination or interview marking scheme.

content_sections.heading: RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Venue
content_sections.text: Candidates must report to the Office of the Director, Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences, Ranchi , during the prescribed reporting hours.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Applications not submitted in the prescribed format will not be considered. Candidates must be Indian citizens.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RIMS Ranchi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must carry their original certificates for verification and submit self-attested photocopies with the application form. Completed and signed application form. One self-attested passport-size photograph. Matriculation and other educational qualification certificates. Graduation or postgraduate degree certificates and marksheets, where applicable. DCA or Computer Operation certificate, where required. Relevant work experience certificates, where applicable. Category certificate, if claiming reservation or age relaxation. Documents supporting other claims made in the application. Original documents must be produced during the walk-in interview for verification. Candidates should not submit original certificates in place of the prescribed self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q1. Can a 12th pass candidate apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Ayushman Mitra post, provided the candidate also holds a DCA 06 month Certificate.

faq.question: Q2. How is an Ayushman Mitra paid?
faq.answer: The emolument is Rs. 120/- per successful case, not a fixed amount.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application in the prescribed format is needed for each post.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience does a Floor Co-ordinator need?
faq.answer: The post requires 02 years' experience in implementation of a Govt. health programme or Health Insurance in a Manager capacity.

faq.question: Q5. How much age relaxation do women get?
faq.answer: Female candidates get 3 years, over and above the limit for their category.

faq.question: Q6. Will candidates get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many Ayushman Mitra vacancies are for ST candidates?
faq.answer: Of the 100 Ayushman Mitra vacancies, 26 are for ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What language skills does the Ayushman Mitra post need?
faq.answer: Candidates need fluent communication skills in English/Hindi and the Local language.
